legacy_projection_acceptance: byte exact raw CSV SHA256; every old column at every row must match, not tolerance
capture_mode: original service autonomous controls; unchanged HeadlessCapture Load/Run/Sample logic with additive read-only observer only
initial_state: Read original filter x/y and coefficient arrays after Simulator.Start, before first Simulator.Update; no reset assumed or invoked
per_vehicle_phase: Post-update x[0] is the exact Single input consumed by that original filter on this tick, including BaseFrictionCoefficientFactor+AdhesionRandom; base is read directly, not derived from any output
filter_validation_scope: Post-step y[0] only for isolated filter regression; no replacement of prior motion thresholds
instrumentation: Four additional BODY_OBSERVER blocks on captured01. Stripping them recovers helper01 exactly; original Run/Load/controls/trace output code unchanged.

additive_diagnostics.phase: after Simulator.Update and original20column Sample, including a tick0 snapshot after Start
additive_diagnostics.method: direct field reads only via FieldInfo.GetValue; no additional physics or friction getter call
additive_diagnostics.brake_field: CylPressurePSI, nullable if this original brake class does not expose it
additive_diagnostics.missing_optional: empty CSV cell; never a computed substitute
additive_diagnostics.field_name_note: BrakeShoeCoefficientFriction is not an active stored field in the fixed TrainCar source; HuDBrakeShoeFriction is read as-is, not recalculated
